d:
Is madhur aarti bhajan men sabhi devi devtaon ke namon ko liya gaya hai siddhivinayak se aarambh karke kali maiya tak bhagvan ke namon ka smaran kiya gaya hai | is sundar bhajan ka shravan avashy karen evan sabhi devi devtaon ka dhyan karen |
Aarti Utaaro Sab Bhagwan Ki:
Siddhivinayak, Durga Maiya, Vaishno Devi, Banke Bihari, Shiv, Vishnu, Sita Var Ram Ki, Radha Krishna, Dattatreya, Lakshmi, Saraswati, Kali Maiya
Aarti Bhajan: Aarti Utaaroon
Singers: Anuradha Paudwal, Rajiv Chopra
Music Director: Anil Sharma
Lyricist: Rajiv Chopra
Album: Aarti Utaaroon
